faqs.q: How do I apply for design or building practitioner registration?
faqs.a: You can apply for design practitioner registration, building practitioner registration, or for a body corporate through specific application links.

faqs.q: What if I am a professional engineer?
faqs.a: You can apply for professional engineer registration or use the mutual recognition process.

faqs.q: How can I check someone's registration status?
faqs.a: You can check the registration of a professional engineer, design practitioner, or building practitioner using the dedicated check link.

faqs.q: Do I need to renew my registration?
faqs.a: Yes, you can renew your design practitioner, building practitioner, or professional engineer registration online.
